scope: Independent CPU-only review of refreshed second-cap extension fixtures, selection provenance, runner validation record, and cost forecast. No fixture edits, commands that import TTNN, or device launch.

selection.expected_source_rule: All unique coordinator rows in setup/swe85-cap-extensions with verdict=inconclusive and tokens=512, deduplicated by mode/source_job/seed.
selection.result: Exact match across the current coordinator files: 14 served and 24 full selected; all 38 source result/fixture/coordinator SHA-256 references in provenance verified.
selection.fixture_checks: Every candidate preserved its cap512 source prompt_token_ids, chosen continuation IDs, sampling values, and matched seed. Candidate metadata records previous_cap=512/new_cap=1024. Both execution manifests use branches=[], free_run_tokens=1024, free_run_trials=1.
selection.source_hashes: Each provenance source case/result/coordinator hash, candidate fixture hash, and cap-extension source_case_sha256 was checked against disk.

cpu_validation.checks: Served runner validate-only returned 0 for 14 jobs; full returned 0 for 24 jobs; stdout states validation without importing TTNN.

forecast.formula_rechecked: Per selected source free run: overhead = diagnostic_wall_s_including_prefill - decode_wall_s; projected decode = decode_wall_s * 1023 / decode_tokens (511 for all rows); case work = overhead + projected decode. Add max same-mode measured model load once and fixed 180 s first-preparation allowance. Range scales case-work sum by 0.7 and 1.5, then adds the same fixed load/preparation.
forecast.first_preparation_assumption: The 180 s allowance is counted once as a fixed planning margin; it is not a measured second-cap warmup duration. The forecast labels itself planning-only, so this is an explicit assumption rather than a measured performance claim.
forecast.timeout_note: The full upper estimate is 12.643 s above 3600 s; a 5400 s full timeout retains headroom over the stated forecast interval.

limitations: Preparation validity review only; no semantic review of second-cap output because it has not run.
